# pydrivedol

> pydrive (googledrive) with a simple (dict-like or list-like) interface


## Pages in this subsection

- [pydrivedol](pydrivedol.html.md): Google Drive Data Object Layer
- [pydrivedol.base](pydrivedol.base.html.md): Base objects for pydrivedol: download functions, GDFiles, GDReader, GDStore.
- [pydrivedol.ops](pydrivedol.ops.html.md): Key-taking operations, as free functions over the caller’s (possibly wrapped) store.
- [pydrivedol.rest](pydrivedol.rest.html.md): Read a Drive folder over the plain Drive v3 REST API, and mirror it to disk.

## Optional

- [Top-level llms.txt](../llms.txt): Complete documentation index.
